note: The Data2Map layer registry. Datasets carry provenance; layers are what the panel renders. Seeded with `npm run data2map:seed`, read by lib/data2map.ts, and copied from here into PostGIS - the file is the source of truth.

datasets.name: Land price — demo grid
datasets.attribution: Simulated land-price grid generated by Kami3D.
datasets.note: Simulated prices on a hex grid. Vietnam publishes land price tables as legal documents, not as machine-readable polygons - see docs/DATA2MAP.md.

datasets.name: Zoning — demo parcels
datasets.attribution: Simulated zoning parcels generated by Kami3D.
datasets.note: Simulated land-use parcels. Real zoning is published as decisions and drawings, not as open GeoJSON.

datasets.name: Amenities (OpenStreetMap)
datasets.note: Schools, hospitals, markets and parks as mapped in OpenStreetMap. Fetched per view rather than stored, per the ODbL guidance on derived databases.

datasets.name: Footfall — simulated hourly counts
datasets.attribution: Simulated footfall counts generated by Kami3D.
datasets.note: No open dataset of hourly footfall exists. Simulated, and labelled as such wherever it is drawn.

datasets.name: Population
datasets.note: Gridded population, used as a background signal behind footfall. Not yet imported.

datasets.name: Fleet traces — simulated GPS
datasets.attribution: Simulated vehicle traces generated by Kami3D.
datasets.note: Fleet telemetry is private by nature; these are generated traces with the same shape as real ones.

datasets.name: Road network (OpenStreetMap)
datasets.note: The road graph a route is drawn on. Fetched per view rather than stored.

datasets.name: Story points — curated
datasets.attribution: Kami3D story entries, citing the linked sources.
datasets.note: Written by Kami3D and cited, the same rule the animal timeline uses: an annotation is our summary of a source, never a copied text or an interpolated shape.

datasets.name: Vegetation index (NDVI)
datasets.note: Needs a tile pipeline the project does not have yet; the licence is settled, the infrastructure is not.
